title: California v. Greenwood (1988)
key_points: Holding: Federally, there is no expectation of privacy in trash left at the curb for collection.
New Jersey: State v. Hempele, 120 N.J. 182 (1990) recognizes a privacy interest in curbside trash; police need reasonable suspicion to search it.
officer_notes: Scenario: You collect a suspect's garbage bags from the curb.
Takeaway: NJ requires reasonable suspicion first.
